_regression.source: real map: Sawada (scripted hamlet), the manifest as it stood BEFORE the fan-toe truncation. GM ruling 2026-08-17 on the fan-toe SUNBURST that future-work.md carried as an open question: 'It sounds like you are telling me that this is based on a shape which is realistic, but that the degree to which it is true, like the angles in particular are themselves not realistic ... I would like for us to be rendering things that are realistic. So if this is a thing that needs to be fixed, then I would like it to be fixed.' At two places on Inashiro eight to ten bunds 130-254 ft long converge on a ~10 ft stretch of the collector bank at apex angles of 7.5-14.3 deg. The radial convergence is authentic - a cascade fan does narrow to its outfall - but a paddy is a level bunded basin and a wedge that acute is two aze with no floor between them for its last yards, so it can be neither leveled nor transplanted. Frozen here because the fix is in the carve and a green map would otherwise leave the rule with nothing holding it honest. The check reports 7 needle apexes under 15 deg on this manifest; 6 of them are paddy plot_rings and the seventh comes from a differently-derived ring at (1232,2039), so the two counts do not reconcile by inspecting plot_rings alone (settlement-review, 2026-08-17).
